name: Hooded Brawler — exert's "When you do, it gets +2/+2" fires as a trigger
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (four exert cards shared the wording). 'You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.' was neither a static effect (the sentence opens with When) nor a triggered ability (the line does not), so nothing could ever apply it. extractTriggeredAbilities now offers the reflexive trigger, and 'it' is the exerter. The Brawler is 5/4; the Bears are untouched.

call: it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
You may exert this creature as it attacks. When you do, it gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
